skeleton.type: custom Blender armature (Meshy auto-rig is humanoid only)

skin: Blender bone-heat weights, fallback nearest-bone distance weights for any unweighted vertex
move_speed_note: root speed matching the planted foot of the in-place cycle; drive the animal at this speed to avoid skating

behaviour.suggested_route: tied at the stable / cart rank; graze or idle in place and shift 1 cell; with a cart it walks the market road loop (walk only, no run in town)
role_idles: graze at the trough or hay pile (main)
behaviour.rule: always moving or doing something; never idle in place more than ~15 s

textures: baseColor + normal + ORM from Tripo, 1024/512/256 for LOD0/1/2
